definitions.explanation: A class of man-made, resin-like materials produced by chemical synthesis from petroleum or other feedstocks — in ordinary Japanese, the technical-sounding equivalent of "plastic." Used on product labels, in materials science, and in regulatory language, often where the looser everyday word プラスチック would sound too casual.

examples.japanese: {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧{合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This part is made of lightweight synthetic resin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内装|ないそう}→内装：06425_naisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Synthetic resin has come to be used widely in car interiors in place of metal.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧ (synthesis, combining) and ⟦{樹脂|じゅし}→樹脂：17424_jushi⟧ (resin — originally the sticky exudate of trees). Although ⟦{樹脂|じゅし}→樹脂：17424_jushi⟧ originally meant tree resin, in modern usage {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし} is essentially the formal Japanese word for plastic. Labels on household products and packaging often use it rather than ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧ because it sounds more technical and precise.

USAGE:
- Appears on product labels such as material-composition notes: {材質|ざいしつ}：{合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし} (Material: plastic).
- Used in manufacturing, chemistry, and environmental contexts — e.g., discussions of plastic waste often use {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし} when sources cite statistics.
- In everyday conversation, speakers usually default to ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧ or more specific names like ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧ (PET bottle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made of synthetic resin
- {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容器|ようき}→容器：03656_youki⟧: a synthetic-resin container
- {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to use synthetic resin
- {熱可塑性|ねつかそせい}{合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}: thermoplastic resin
- {合成樹脂|ごうせいじゅし}⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: synthetic-resin paint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{樹脂|じゅし}→樹脂：17424_jushi⟧: resin — the broader term, including both natural tree resin and synthetic resin
- ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧: plastic — the everyday loanword
- ⟦ビニール→ビニール：11140_biniiru⟧: vinyl — often used colloquially for plastic sheeting or bags
- ポリエチレン: polyethylene — a specific common plastic
- ⟦{合成繊維|ごうせいせんい}→合成繊維：22280_gouseiseni⟧: synthetic fiber — a related category of man-made materials used for fabrics
